The '''Sardine''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Spring]], [[Fall]], and [[Winter]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring, Fall, or Winter or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|40}}.

Sardines can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Map==
The Sardine can be found in the ocean.

==Tailoring==
Sardine can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Sardines can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is blue Sardine [[Roe]].

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Sardine may be randomly requested in [[Spring]], [[Fall]], or [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|120}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-5 Sardines to be caught in [[Spring]], [[Fall]], or [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|40}} per fish.  (You get to keep the fish).
*'''Aquatic Overpopulation:''' [[Demetrius]] may request 10 Sardines to be caught in [[Spring]] at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] outside the [[Mayor's Manor]] for a reward of gold equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.
*Two Sardines are requested by [[Midnight Squid]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 8.
*Two Sardines are requested by [[Squid]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 10.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Removed from most Summer quests and garbage can items.  Added iridium quality.  Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].}}
{{History|1.5|Special Order quest added.}}
{{History|1.6.4|Can no longer be requested by [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] in a [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|Fishing Help Wanted quest]] during [[Summer]].}}
